% A named imakeidx index with a title and the makeindex option -l,
% printed after \indexprologue from an \include file that \includeonly
% keeps, while it skips another. The main index is printed from the same
% file, while a named index of places is printed in the main file. The
% document does not load hyperref, and the .ind files beside the document,
% from an earlier build that loaded it, use \hyperpage.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{imakeidx}
\makeindex
\makeindex[name=test-staleaux-ind-incl-plain-places]
\makeindex[name=test-staleaux-ind-incl-plain-people,title=Index of people,options=-l]
\includeonly{test-staleaux-ind-incl-plain/back}
\begin{document}
Euler\index[test-staleaux-ind-incl-plain-people]{Euler} ate ice cream\index[test-staleaux-ind-incl-plain-people]{Ice cream} on an iceberg\index[test-staleaux-ind-incl-plain-people]{Iceberg}.
An apple\index{Apple} from Basel\index[test-staleaux-ind-incl-plain-places]{Basel}.
\include{test-staleaux-ind-incl-plain/skipped}
\include{test-staleaux-ind-incl-plain/back}
\printindex[test-staleaux-ind-incl-plain-places]
\end{document}
